title: Constant integral scalar adjunction on derived strict towers
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with their actual integer inclusion $A=\mathcal O_E\to B=\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the ordinary derived categories of strict constant integral module towers [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. Define the constant ring map by applying the constant-sheaf functor to that inclusion, and the ordinary tower extension and restriction as pointwise sheafified tensor [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] and scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Define $T_W$ and $U_W$ by exact localization: tensor is exact because $B$ is finite free over $A$. Its adjunction $T_W\dashv U_W$ is the descent of the ordinary scalar adjunction with tensor unit $x\mapsto1\otimes x$. Define the compatible constant coefficient datum [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] by the canonical constant inverse-image isomorphisms and their naturality with respect to the integral inclusion.

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition), 0940 (section-derived-limits), 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map); sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8I (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor). Auxiliary in the item proof Steps 2--6.

proof.text: For tensor_exact, use the proved integral_basis auxiliary theorem of CompletedIntegralFiniteFree for the actual integer inclusion, with the algebra structure induced by i. Its liftedBasis construction gives a basis of the ULift coefficient rings with precisely the lifted inclusion as algebra map. No completed coefficient object or arbitrary witness is chosen.

Apply the proved basisSheafIso auxiliary construction of ConstantFiniteFreeSectionBasis to this lifted basis on the pro-etale site of W. Its inverse identifies the finite product of the source unit module with the target unit restricted along constantMap. The coefficient map is definitionally the specified constant sheafification of the lifted integer inclusion.

Apply scalarTowerExtension_exact to that unit-module isomorphism. This proves both finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation for the pointwise extension functor on whole strict towers. The existing definitions T, U and scalarAdj then use this exactness for the unchanged localization and adjunction constructions.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03CY and 03EK; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0940. Existing proved integral-basis and constant-sheaf basis auxiliaries followed by exactness of finite-free extension on whole towers, formalized by A9.
